title: Transport of a supplied constant complex through a marked slice origin
statement: Let X be any scheme, B finite commutative, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet and phi:constant(B)->R an isomorphism. Use the exact fixed-scalar chart restriction F_V of [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-slice-restriction]. Let K be any derived R-module object, V an etale chart, and L an etale ULift(B)-module derived object on V.left, with a supplied isomorphism comparisonUpperStar.mapDerivedCategory(L) ~= F_V.mapDerivedCategory(K). For every W->V and every algebraic B-module cochain complex P, a supplied isomorphism from the derived etale pullback of L on W.left to the etale constant realization of the universe-lifted P implies an isomorphism of the actual ringed proetale W-slice restriction of K with the actual W-slice restriction of completedAdicDerivedChange(phi)(Q(finiteModelConstantComplex(X,B,P))). Realizations are [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. There is no boundedness or local constancy hypothesis on K, L or P; no origin or model existence is asserted.

source.place: Small-site and constant-scalar comparison 099R, 099Y, 09AL; naturality on complexes

proof.text: Construct the constant-scalar restriction equivalence for a locally bijective map from a constant ring presheaf to a ring sheaf, using module sheafification. Apply it on the W slice and compose with the site equivalence Over(W) ~= W.left_proet. The resulting equivalence identifies ordinary ringed restriction with finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction. Reflect exactness through this equivalence, and use the exact-functor factorization at the chosen complex representative to obtain the derived identification.

Use the upper-star composition isomorphism and the comparison/pullback square to pull the supplied origin marking from V to W. Apply derived comparison to the supplied etale constant-complex isomorphism; the constant-sheaf comparison is a natural isomorphism of functors, so it applies to the entire unbounded complex including its differentials.

Show that constant-module sheafification followed by constant-scalar restriction is naturally isomorphic to the fixed-module constant-sheaf functor. Restriction along the isomorphism phi is an equivalence, hence so is its exact derived functor. Apply the existing canonical derived scalar adjunction pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction: its unit is invertible and its left functor is definitionally completedAdicDerivedChange. Combine the inverse unit with exact-functor factorization, the natural constant-sheaf localization isomorphism to identify the fixed-coefficient image of the completed constant model with the proetale constant complex.

Compose the two identifications with the proetale constant complex. Lift the resulting isomorphism through the fully faithful derived W-slice coordinate equivalence to obtain the isomorphism of the two actual ringed slice restrictions.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficient_slice_model_transport
    (X : Scheme.{t})
    (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R))) (V : X.Etale)
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))))
    (hL : Nonempty
      ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B)) V.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj L ≅
        (finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R φ V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
    (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ) :
        Nonempty
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStar
              (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B)) g.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj L ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (((constantSheaf W.left.smallEtaleTopology
                (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
                (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                  ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom
                  ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) →
        Nonempty
          (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
              ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
              ((toProEt X).obj W) K ≅
            ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
              ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
              ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X φ).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P))))
